units.source_text: 就是在那样的温泉旅馆里，也有各式各样的男人前来向她求爱。

en.t: Even at that kind of hot spring inn, all sorts of men came to court her.

units.source_text: 他们既不是真心实意，也不是乱开玩笑。

en.t: They were neither truly sincere nor merely joking around.

units.source_text: 她既不认真，也不当儿戏，一概委婉而巧妙地躲开。

en.t: She neither took them seriously nor treated them as childish play, but gently and skillfully evaded them all.

units.source_text: 同时，她也不像其他女人那样渲染这类风流韵事，加以吹嘘。

en.t: At the same time, unlike other women, she did not embellish such romantic affairs or boast about them.

units.source_text: 因此有一回，一个学生哥对她说走了嘴：

en.t: Because of that, one time a student let something slip when he said to her:
